411: /// Optional GPU backend input, generated from the same validated source samples,
412: /// camera, and display transform as the CPU oracle. Every row is a 16-byte float4.
413: /// Parameters: 0 origin/halfW, 1 forward/halfH, 2 right/radius, 3 up/panelHalfExtent,
414: /// 4 Bradford ratio/exposure, 5 sample count/area count/minimum depth/grid count.
415: /// Sample color.w is zero for a point/directional source or a one-based area index.
416: public struct StudyComputeInput: Sendable {
417:     public let width: Int
418:     public let height: Int
419:     public let parameters: [SIMD4<Float>]
420:     public let samples: [SIMD4<Float>]
421:     public let areas: [SIMD4<Float>]
422: 
423:     public init(scene: LightingScene, width: Int = 192) throws {
424:         let setup = try StudySetup(scene: scene, width: width, quality: .interactive)
425:         let c = vec(setup.geometry.center), camera = setup.camera
426:         let origin = vec(camera.position) - c
427:         let samples = setup.lighting.computeSamples(relativeTo: c)
428:         let areas = setup.lighting.computeAreas(relativeTo: c)
429:         self.width = width; self.height = setup.height
430:         self.samples = samples; self.areas = areas
431:         parameters = [pack(origin, setup.halfW), pack(vec(camera.forward), setup.halfH),
432:                       pack(vec(camera.right), setup.geometry.radius), pack(vec(camera.up), setup.geometry.panelHalfExtent),
433:                       setup.transform.computeParameters,
434:                       .init(Float(samples.count / 3), Float(areas.count / 3), Float(CameraFraming.minimumDepthMeters), 8)]
435:     }
436: }
437: 
438: private struct StudySetup {
439:     let camera: CameraFraming
440:     let geometry: StudyGeometry
441:     let lighting: StudyLighting
442:     let transform: PreviewColorTransform
443:     let height: Int
444:     let halfW: Double
445:     let halfH: Double
446: 
447:     init(scene: LightingScene, width: Int, quality: StudyQuality) throws {

154: actor StudyRenderEngine {
155:     static let shared = StudyRenderEngine()
156:     // Bound both the number of scene snapshots and retained RGBA storage.
157:     // Four small frames fit; at 192 × 128 the byte limit retains at most two.
158:     static let maximumCachedFrames = 4
159:     static let maximumCachedPixelBytes = 256 * 1024
160:     static let maximumCachedMaskBytes = 64 * 1024
161: 
162:     private struct CacheKey: Equatable, Sendable {
163:         let scene: LightingScene
164:         let width: Int
165:         let subject: StudySubject
166: 
167:         init?(scene: LightingScene, width: Int, subject: StudySubject) {
168:             // A hit must never bypass validation of metadata that the renderer
169:             // otherwise rejects. Leave errors and their ordering to the actual
170:             // render path when validation fails.
171:             guard (try? scene.validated()) != nil else { return nil }
172:             var snapshot = scene
173:             snapshot.lights = scene.lights.map { light in
174:                 var copy = light
175:                 // Display names do not affect pixels. Do not retain arbitrary
176:                 // Unicode storage: the 80-character limit is not a byte limit.
177:                 copy.name = ""
178:                 return copy
179:             }
180:             // Retain every other scene value, including complete optics, light
181:             // order, camera, exposure and room metadata. Equality is exact;
182:             // there is no hash-only or rounded-coordinate cache identity.
183:             self.scene = snapshot
184:             self.width = width
185:             self.subject = subject
186:         }
187:     }
188: 
189:     private enum State { case unchecked, cpu, metal(any StudyComputeBackend) }
190:     private var state = State.unchecked
191:     // Least recently used first. Validated keys contain at most twelve lights
192:     // and only bounded, fixed-size values after display names are removed.
193:     private var frameCache = StudyFrameCache<CacheKey, StudyRenderedFrame>(
194:         maximumCount: StudyRenderEngine.maximumCachedFrames,
195:         maximumPixelBytes: StudyRenderEngine.maximumCachedPixelBytes,
196:         maximumMaskBytes: StudyRenderEngine.maximumCachedMaskBytes)
197:     private let additionalCancellation: @Sendable () -> Bool
198:     private let makeComputeBackend: @Sendable () throws -> any StudyComputeBackend
199: 
200:     var cacheUsage: (count: Int, pixelBytes: Int, maskBytes: Int) {
201:         (frameCache.count, frameCache.pixelBytes, frameCache.maskBytes)
202:     }
